# nah_disk (Resource)

Manages a NahCloud disk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nah_disk" "data" {
  project = nah_project.app.slug
  name    = "data"
  size_gb = 100
  region  = "eu-west-1"
  type    = "ssd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `region` (String) Region. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `size_gb` (Number) Disk size in GiB. Expansion updates in place; shrinking replaces the disk.
- `type` (String) Disk type. Changing it replaces the disk.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque stable resource ID.
- `project_id` (String) Opaque owning project ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nah_disk.data my-app/DISK_ID
```
